_doc: Parameters of the stratified audio scenarios (strata.py). Hand-chosen 2026-11-20, then re-weighted the same day with the first numbers of the human profile mined from real sessions (pauses inside a thought p50 1.7 s, p90 5 s, p99 18 s; thoughts of p50 2 / p90 7 finals; half the Spanish finals end mid-clause; the agent's own voice reaching the microphone). A list is a set of choices drawn with the flow's seeded random; a scalar is fixed.

human_pause._measured: Checked against the human profile's es voice pause_between_fragments_ms (n=1643): p50 1744, p90 4993, p99 18251 ms. This log-normal through p50 1700 / p90 5000 matches p50 and p90 within 3 %; its p99 is ~12 s (shorter tail). EN (n=38, low_n) is not used: the profile says to prefer es.

_cells: each pause length is a cell; 300 ms is reported but, per the profile, lives inside a final
